statusMeaning: Original baseline labels retained unchanged. BASE_EXISTS means related code only; statuses are not operational certification.

mergeRules.BASE_EXISTS: extend existing ownership; do not clone it
mergeRules.PARTIAL: finish existing implementation; verify every claimed function
mergeRules.PROPOSED: research in existing owner only if measurable value
